newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Ill. Superconductor view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Ill. Superconductor view cut.

text.p: Gruntal & Co said Thursday it had reduced its estimates for Illinois Superconductor Corp, with 1997 being cut to a loss of $1.99 a share from a loss of $1.65, and 1998 being cut to a profit of $0.25 from a profit of $0.30.
It trimmed its price target on the stock to $18 from $20, but maintained its strong buy rating.
Gruntal analyst Mark Langley said the firm is taking a more conservative stance on revenues as it undergoes a switch to higher-margin RangeMaster filters and to reflect recent financing terms.
Illinois Superconductor said on June 10 it had secured a $15 million financing facility and that the funds would be used for working capital and general corporate purposes.
The company had previously withdrawn a one million share offering.

"The shares have been weak lately with what we believe to be concerns over the financing, moreso than the acceptance of ISCO's products in the marketplace," Langley said. "We believe that the weakness presents an attractive opportunity for aggressive growth accounts."
